description: The strict predecessors of a node in a restriction-closed function tree are exactly its restrictions to smaller domains.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.functionTree_predecessors.{u} {θ : Ordinal.{u}} {X : Type u}
  (S : Set (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.FunctionNode θ X))
  (hS : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.RestrictionClosed S)
  (s t : (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.functionTree S hS).carrier) :
  s < t ↔ ∃ b, ∃ (h : b < (↑t).fst), ↑s = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.restrictNode (↑t) b ⋯
